items.markdown:
Thailand's Long-Term Resident (LTR) Visa provides a 10-year residency package split into two 5-year segments for [Wealthy Global Citizens, Wealthy Pensioners, and Remote Workers](https://ltr.boi.go.th/). `Applicants must meet specific financial criteria, maintain health insurance, and apply through the Board of Investment`.[](https://www.hlbthai.com/thailand-long-term-resident-ltr-visa/) [[1]](https://www.hlbthai.com/thailand-long-term-resident-ltr-visa/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kx9T3_qLGYs&t=166)[[3]](https://www.legalink.net/en/publications/newsletters/changed-rules-for-ltr-long-term-resident-visas-in-thailand/6210/)[[4]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/long-term-resident-visa)

Visa Categories and Financial Rules

- **Wealthy Global Citizens:** Hold at least $1 million in total assets and investments in Thailand.[](https://www.hlbthai.com/thailand-long-term-resident-ltr-visa/) [[1]](https://kpmg.com/xx/en/our-insights/gms-flash-alert/flash-alert-2025-040.html)
- **Wealthy Pensioners:** Age 50 or older with an annual passive income of at least $80,000, or $40,000 paired with a $250,000 investment in Thai property or bonds.[](https://www.hlbthai.com/thailand-long-term-resident-ltr-visa/) [[1]](https://www.thaiembassy.com/thailand-visa/thailand-visa-types)
- **Work-from-Thailand Professionals:** Remote staff for major overseas companies earning at least $80,000 yearly (or $40,000 with a Master’s degree).[](https://www.hlbthai.com/thailand-long-term-resident-ltr-visa/) 
- **Highly-Skilled Professionals:** Experts in target industries working in Thailand, earning $80,000 yearly (or $40,000 with a Master's degree).[](https://www.hlbthai.com/thailand-long-term-resident-ltr-visa/) 

General Requirements

- **Health Insurance:** Policy covering at least $50,000, 10 months of remaining coverage, or $100,000 in a bank account.
- **Application Fee:** 50,000 Thai Baht for the 10-year visa endorsement.
- **Process:** Register and submit qualifications online via the Thailand Board of Investment before final visa issuance.[](https://www.hlbthai.com/thailand-long-term-resident-ltr-visa/)
